title: [Audit] 📊 Platform Volume & API Keys
description: The unfiltered firehose, quarantined so the forensic dashboards stay readable.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `All events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Events that survive the noise gate.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | STATS `Signal` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main","elastic.maintenance") | STATS `Infra noise` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Successful authentication events. Elasticsearch logs one per authenticated request, so credentials making many calls generate most of them.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "authentication_success" | STATS `Bulk authn` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Distinct HTTP requests behind the audited events. One request often emits several audit records, so this is lower than the event count.
Percentage of the firehose that survives the noise gate. The lower this is, the more the other dashboards are earning their keep.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS total = COUNT(*), sig = COUNT(CASE(band == "signal", 1, null)) | EVAL `Signal share` = ROUND(sig * 1.0 / total, 4) | KEEP `Signal share`

config.title: Signal vs noise over time
config.description: Stream graph of the four volume bands. The signal band is what every other dashboard shows.

config.content:
### 📊 The quarantine dashboard

Every other dashboard applies a **noise gate**. This one deliberately does not, so the
firehose stays measurable without drowning the forensic views.

- **`infra-noise`** — `cluster:monitor/main` + `elastic.maintenance` health traffic
- **`query-noise`** — search-phase internals, reader contexts, PITs, `connection_granted`
- **`authn-volume`** — bulk `authentication_success`, one per request
- **`signal`** — everything else: what the other dashboards read

Elasticsearch stamps an API key's **creator's** email on every event the key emits, so a busy
key's traffic resolves to a person's name on the identity panels — check the `api_key` column
before reading a name as a human.

config.title: API key throughput
config.description: Request volume per named API key.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY api_key = attributes.api_key.name | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 12

config.title: Volume band over time
config.description: Absolute event volume split into the four bands.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL band = CASE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance"), "infra-noise", attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "connection_granted", "query-noise", attributes.event.action == "authentication_success", "authn-volume", "signal") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), band

config.title: Audit volume by source service
config.description: Elasticsearch versus Kibana audit volume over time.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source = resource.attributes.service.name

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name)) BY action = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Highest-volume identities
config.description: Unfiltered volume leaderboard — this is where the machine traffic shows up.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.event.action) BY actor, actor_kind | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15
